rule: Mendelian: ClinGen, Gene2Phenotype, Genomics England, Orphanet, UniProt literature, or ClinVar with a pathogenic variant. GWAS: credible set with locus-to-gene score >= 0.5. Somatic: IntOGen, Cancer Gene Census. Strongest wins. 'none' needs every evidence row read and genetic data for the disease.
